Where Replaice adds value

Choose a workflow with measurable value

Map the current process, establish a baseline for turnaround time or manual effort, and select a use case with a clear owner and success measure.

Make enterprise knowledge usable

Connect approved documents, data and applications. HybridRAG Agent retrieves relevant context so teams can check the sources behind an answer.

Put the workflow into production

Define permissions, human approval points and exception paths. Track completion time, rework and escalations before extending the workflow.
